decisions.reason: A safety shoe line is core to the firm and was launched only a year ago, so its value is still uncertain and carrying it in an existing range costs little.
This comfort insole is a cheap accessory that complements the shoe range, so keeping the option open costs little, though the firm's several insole launches overlap.
The supportive insole has low carrying cost and its demand is still unresolved, but overlap with the other new insoles raises some risk of consolidation.
The ergonomic series has its own dedicated page, which signals strategic commitment and early promise in line with the firm's innovation focus.
Firefighter boots are a specialized niche whose certification investment is already sunk, so keeping them while demand becomes clearer is worthwhile.
Featuring the moulded insole on the home page shows management's high expectations, and the option is cheap to keep while results come in.
